programme.desc: Huang Rong bergegas untuk menyelamatkan Zhou Botong dan Guo Jing, malangnya dia erjatuh ke dalam sungai. Setelah tersedar, dia mendapati dia berada di sebuah pulau. Ou Yangke dan Hong Qigong turut berada di pulau tersebut.

programme.title: AMUSING RACE SEASON 2
programme.desc: Episod ini menyaksikan Wind, Rickman, Lin Zhi Xiang dan Baki menerokai Kuala Terengganu untuk menyertai pelbagai cabaran unik. Suasana riuh dengan aksi mencabar fizikal serta hukuman mencuit hati bagi peserta yang kalah.

programme.title: WOMEN WALK THE LINE
programme.desc: Hao Shuai, saudara sepupu Bing Wen, pulang dari luar negara dan tinggal bersama Wen buat sementara waktu. Gu Qiao merayu pelanggannya Chu Chu supaya tidak menamatkan keahliannya di Pusat Spa dan Penjagaan Kesihatan.

programme.title: YOUR FINESSE
programme.desc: Fei Ren dan Gao Qiang berjaya memasuki Bandar Jianggong bersama Gong Xin, namun ditangkap oleh Fu Ling. Dalam usaha melarikan diri, Fei Ren dan Gong Xin secara tidak sengaja mencabut pedang pusaka Jianggong.

programme.title: MY TWIN LOVER
programme.desc: Hou Ming berusaha memajukan perniagaan kedai barangan terpakai dengan mengambil Ah Chang, Ah Ping dan Ah Man sebagai pekerja. Bagi memperluas jualan, dia turut melancarkan laman web khas untuk mempromosikan produknya.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Fu Mi tidak dapat menerima hakikat peninggalan An Jie dan menegas untuk menyediakan makanan kegemaran An Jie. Zi Qian dan Zhi Han cuba menenangkan hati Fu Mi. Pada masa yang sama, Li Ping merasa risau dengan perubahan sikap Qing Tian.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: An Jie menenangkan Fu Mi di tandas, manakala Fu Mi terkejut mendapati gaya pertuturan Qing Tian mirip An Jie. An Jie cuba membongkarkan identiti sebenar diri, namun niatnya terhalang apabila tiba-tiba mengalami pendarahan hidung.

programme.title: THE QUEEN OF NEWS 2
programme.desc: Man mendapatkan semula rekod perubatan Paula dan membersihkan nama wanita itu. Man dan Lau Yim menemui satu rahsia yang mengejutkan pada komputer tablet lama milik Paula yang menunjukkan Paula bergelut dengan sekumpulan kawan.

programme.title: PURSUIT OF JADE
programme.desc: Episod ini Chang Yu ditahan atas tuduhan membunuh sebelum dibebaskan secara rahsia oleh Ketua Polis Wang. Keadaan semakin rumit apabila Yan Zheng pula dituduh membunuh sehinggalah kehadiran rakan Yan Zheng membantu membebaskan mereka.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF HEROES
programme.desc: Semasa bergelut dengan Ou Yangke, Huang Rong mengaktifkan mekanisme yang dipasangkan olehnya, menyebabkan batu besar menghempap kaki Ou Yangke. Ou Yangfeng dan Guo Jing turut muncul di pulau tersebut.

programme.title: AMUSING RACE SEASON 2
programme.desc: Episod ini menyaksikan Wind, Rickman, Lin Zhi Xiang dan Baki berada di Kedah untuk menyahut pelbagai cabaran unik. Suasana gamat dengan pelbagai tugasan mencuit hati serta hukuman kelakar bagi peserta yang tewas.

programme.title: WOMEN WALK THE LINE
programme.desc: Bing Wen menghadapi rintangan ketika membuat rundingan perjanjian untuk mengambil alih sebuah syarikat bagi pihak Shu Mei Corp tapi mendapat campur tangan Yuan Ge. Dia memberi jaminan akan memeterai perjanjian tersebut.

programme.title: YOUR FINESSE
programme.desc: Yuan Yujiu memberi Fu Ling tujuh hari untuk memilih calon suami antara Fei Ren dan Gong Xin, atau mereka semua dihukum mati. Syarat kejam ini mencetuskan rasa curiga dan konflik antara kedua-dua lelaki itu.

programme.title: MY TWIN LOVER
programme.desc: Coco dan 3 orang kawannya mengesyaki Hou Ming (sebenarnya Hou Qin) adalah anak kembar dan mempunyai seorang abang atau adik yang wajahnya mirip benar dengannya. Mereka menggeledah bilik Hou Ming (Hou Qin).

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: An Jie menenangkan Fu Mi di tandas, manakala Fu Mi terkejut mendapati gaya pertuturan Qing Tian mirip An Jie. An Jie cuba membongkarkan identiti sebenar diri, namun niatnya terhalang apabila tiba-tiba mengalami pendarahan hidung.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: An Jie mengalami pendarahan hidung teruk selepas mendakwa Chang Sheng terlibat dalam kes pembunuhan. Walau bagaimanapun, Chang Sheng menafikan tuduhan tersebut dan mencabar agar laporan polis dibuat sekiranya terdapat bukti.

programme.title: THE QUEEN OF NEWS 2
programme.desc: Man memujuk keluarga mangsa untuk memberikan temu bual, namun Kayin muncul dan cuba menyakinkan ahli keluarga tersebut bahawa SNK mempunyai pengaruh yang lebih kuat. Lau Yim membuat persefahaman dengan Kaying untuk berkongsi maklumat.

programme.title: PURSUIT OF JADE
programme.desc: Yan Zheng rupa-rupanya adalah seorang jeneral terkenal dari Chongzhou. Nama sebenarnya adalah Xie Zheng. Beliau diserang hendap ketika mengetuai satu ekspedisi ketenteraan, menyebabkan ke seluruh pasukannya dibinasakan

programme.title: MY STAR FAMILY 3
programme.desc: Adik perempuan Keira, Yu Ming, menjadi popular di media sosial, setelah video nyanyiannya menjadi tular dalam talian. Obsesinya terhadap nyanyian dan populariti itu telah merenggangkan hubungannya dengan keluarganya.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF HEROES
programme.desc: Dalam perjalanan setelah meninggalkan pulau terbiar, mereka diselamatkan oleh kapal besar Wan Yan Honglie yang kebetulan lalu. Wan Yan Honglie mengurung Guo Jing, Huang Rong dan Hong Qigong. Dia meminta Ou Yanfeng membantunya.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music." The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music." The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down on a yacht with friends and laughter. Finally, Tianran travels to Baisha for the "La'aomen" harvest festival, where the local ethnic Li people sing, dance and celebrate their most important crop: "Mountain Orchid Rice".

programme.title: Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan
programme.desc: Nunchucks. Dark shades. A yellow jumpsuit. That unmistakable nose wipe. Blinding punches and the snake feint - one name says it all: Bruce Lee, the man who brought Chinese martial arts to the world. But every legend has a beginning - and his is less well known. It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots - following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: Ad Break
programme.desc: Ad Break

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing's Hutongs
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture. In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May zigzag their way through the Hutongs and the Forbidden City for a mouth-watering experience full of ancient and modern delicacies. Starring German designer Katrin, Russian artist Liuba and photographer Feng Yu from Beijing, our hosts are taking you along a journey that features fried noodles, dim sum, pancakes and co.!

Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots - following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: Shunde's Waterways: where business smarts meet everyday life
programme.desc: Shunde, a district in Guangdong Province, lies in the Pearl River Delta, north of Hong Kong - a water-rich region that lives by water and knows how to turn it into opportunity. Once, boats carried silk down its canals from small villages, building a legacy of trade. Today, Xiangyunsha (gambiered Canton gauze) is a global fashion icon, and historic spots like Mingshi Garden draw tourists and locals alike. With water as their muse and grit as their guide, Shunde folks keep business thriving while making life sweeter - that's the quiet wisdom flowing through their rivers. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia are setting out to explore more with the locals...

programme.title: Shunde's Waterways: where business smarts meet everyday life
programme.desc: Shunde, a district in Guangdong Province, lies in the Pearl River Delta, north of Hong Kong - a water-rich region that lives by water and knows how to turn it into opportunity. Once, boats carried silk down its canals from small villages, building a legacy of trade. Today, Xiangyunsha (gambiered Canton gauze) is a global fashion icon, and historic spots like Mingshi Garden draw tourists and locals alike. With water as their muse and grit as their guide, Shunde folks keep business thriving while making life sweeter - that's the quiet wisdom flowing through their rivers. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia are setting out to explore more with the locals...

programme.title: I'M LIVE - W24
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the quartet W24! This band burst into the music scene in March 2018 with the song Always Missing You. Composed of vocalist Cheong Ho-won guitarist Kim Yun-soo keyboardist Aaron Park and drummer Kim Jong-gil they compose write and produce all the songs they release and perform. Their name is short for World 24 Hours expressing the band's desire for their music to be heard 24 hours a day around the world. Thanks to their outstanding talents W24 won the Focus Award at the Asia Artist Awards in 2018 and the Best K-Pop Rookie Award at the 2019 Korea Culture Entertainment Grande Prize. Also they participated in The Asian Top Band a project to discover world-class musicians involving 8 Asian countries as the Korean representatives and became the winners. In this episode W24 performs Once Upon A Time Breath Under The Tree and more to show off thier musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these four talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Zitten
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Zitten! This artist made his debut in 2005 with the EP Rock Doves and has been nourishing the hearts of countless listeners with his delicate lyrical lyrics and heartwarming music since then. Also known for drawing his inspiration from various everyday elements he comforts our souls in a calm yet powerful way. Last December Zitten released the Christmas song All You Need Is A Carol to tell us not to take anything for granted. Then in January this year he started a new project to produce music inspired by places he visited books he read things he purchased and films he watched. The very first outcome of that new project is the song Little forest which he performs on I'm LIVE. He also performs Let's do well Something to say and more to showcase the essence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and meet Zitten!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Choi Gonne
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Choi Gonne! Choi Gonne burst into the music scene in 2010 with the EP 36.5°. Since then she has covered numerous genres of music ranging from folk music rock and jazz not to mention pansori that she learned to sing when she was a child. She's also known for her mix of melodic acoustic themes powerful vocals and sheer lyrical prowess which together make her one of a kind. Last but not least she's the first Korean artist to be invited three times to perform at the Glastonbury Festival in the U.K. In this episode Choi Gonne performs ‘HIGHLANDER’ ‘Eric's song’ and more to display the essence of her artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and meet Choi Gonne!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Band Nah
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is Band Nah! Band Nah is composed of vocalist and guitarist Nah Sang-hyun drummer Kang Hyun-woong and bassist Paiiek. The three students at Seoul National University met each other through the school's composition club and then they released their first song together in 2014 as part of the Why Not Study project organized by the university. The following year they made their official debut in the music scene and have been actively growing their discography and exploring further new facets of their sound since then. Their performance of the song Nights received rave reviews in VOCALPLAY 2 in 2019 and then in 2020 they won the Rookie Green Friends of the Greenplugged-Seoul 2020 making us anticipate their future. In this episode Band Nah performs Lights Life Colour Are You There? All The Time and Nights to show off their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and take a glimpse into their artistic world!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Motte
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Motte! Motte burst into the music scene in September 2017 with the single Tickin’ Then in 2018 she released her first full-length album Between and got nominated for Best Rookie at the prestigious Korean Music Awards. With her stage name based on the Harry Potter saga’s villain Voldemort she sings about the struggles loneliness and many other things that today's youth experiences. She's been also actively expanding her reach in the music industry taking part in the soundtracks of A-TEEN Romance Is a Bonus Book My Strange Hero and When the Camellia Blooms as well as the Beautiful Mint Life Festiva and the Let's Rock Festival. Last but not least she's dubbed the idol of the indie scene thanks to her cute appearance. In this episode Motte performs Don't Run Away Non-Alcohol Fireplace and more to showcase the essence of her musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - HOONS
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the duo HOONS! HOONS is composed of two musicians of the same age - vocalist Lee Sang-hoon and keyboardist Lee Jong-hoon. They met each other in university and then made their debut together in 2016 with the single To You I Am. Thanks to their soft mellow music and sweet lyrics the duo mesmerized the public immediately and they are certainly making their way in the music industry building their fanbase and having their music featured in various TV shows. In this episode HOONS performs I C U Can't hide a love and many others to showcase the essence of their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet the duo!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kim Hyun-chul
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the Korean father of city pop - Kim Hyun-chul! Kim Hyun-chul made his debut in 1989 with the album Kim Hyun-chul Vol. 1. With all songs composed written and arranged by the artist himself he pleasantly surprised the ears and souls of listeners with his jazz-infused music and eventually brought a new wave to the Korean music scene. Throughout his 32-year career Kim Hyun-chul gained much critical acclaim and commercial success earning the nickname the father of Korean city pop. Also his debut album was chosen as one of the All-Time 100 Greatest Albums of Korean Popular Music thanks to the influence it had had on the Korean music scene. Then in 2019 Kim Hyun-chul resumed his career after a break of 13 years and in celebration of the 30th anniversary of his debut. The album garnered much attention not only because of the anticipation of fans and critics but also because he brought an array of Korea’s leading artists along with him. His return coincided with the resurgence of city pop in Korea and he's back once again 2 years later in 2021 to continue with the momentum. Part I of Kim Hyun-chul's performance on I'm LIVE features What's the Matter? City Breeze & Love Song and Tears of Joy. Tune in to the show and meet the legend!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kim Hyun-chul

Drive In My Neighborhood and Fall of the Moon. Tune in to the show and meet the legend!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Jung yup
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is top-notch singer Jung yup! Jung yup made his debut in 2003 as a member of the R&B group Brown Eyed Soul. Composed of four highly talented vocalists the group impressed the ears and souls of the public immediately. Then in 2007 Jung yup performed the song Nothing Better at one concert which went viral on the internet and attracted a lot of attention laying the foundation for his popularity. After a long long break this artist announced his much-anticipated return in April this year. Since then he has released two singles full of love and romance Waltz For You and DRIVE to melt listeners' hearts once again. In this episode Jung yup performs his new songs Waltz For You and DRIVE his all-time greatest hit Nothing Better and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this wonderful vocalist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - LUCY
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the super-talented quartet LUCY! LUCY is composed of violinist Shin Ye-chan vocalist Choi Sang-yeop producer and bassist Cho Won-sang and drummer and vocalist Shin Gwang-il. Since their debut in May last year they have been bringing a new wave to the Korean music scene especially with their unusual band configuration featuring a violinist. This past June the quartet released their 4th single album Gatcha! to engrave their name in the minds of the public and their first solo concert sold out in a minute proving their growing influence. In this episode LUCY performs I Got U Buddy Jogging and more to show off their prowess. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented quartet!

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10

programme.title: KONA MAI 2026
programme.desc: Rehatkan minda anda pada penghujung hari bersama Shah, Faruk & Mimie dalam segmen KONA MAI. Segmen ini membawakan pilihan lagu santai, pengisian rohani, serta seleksi lagu-lagu kesukaan anda di Tapaw Lagu @ Kafe Muzik. Sebelum melelapkan mata, nikmati alunan lagu-lagu melankolik terkini, bahasa Melayu, Inggeris, dan Indonesia untuk menemani malam anda dengan penuh kedamaian.

programme.title: GENG PAGI MUTIARA
programme.desc: Mulakan Pagi anda dengan penuh bersemangat bersama Chombi dan Bambam!\\n Segmen ini menyajikan gabungan lengkap untuk memulakan hari anda dengan positif—daripada pengisian rohani menerusi bacaan Al-Quran, nasyid, dan Santai Nurani, hinggalah kepada berita sahih, laporan trafik semasa, tajuk-tajuk akhbar utama, serta topik pagi yang santai dan menghiburkan. Jangan lupa layan lagu-lagu permintaan anda dalam slot Layan Pagi sebelum melangkah ke tengah hari!

programme.title: FOKUS MUTIARA
programme.desc: Sambil buat kerja atau berehat, penyampai kami Azie, Elly , Mimie & Fazrinah sedia menemani dengan pelbagai maklumat berguna dan hiburan menarik. Dapatkan petua serta tips gaya hidup serta pelbagai perkongsian harian yang terkini. Nikmati juga kelainan irama Bollywood menerusi Syoknya Hindi & mengimbau memori menerusi Everlasting Memory dengan lagu retro Inggeris terbaik serta laporan berita Warta Mutiara secara langsung bagi memastikan anda sentiasa peka dengan isu semasa.

programme.title: PETANG KREW
programme.desc: Petang anda pastinya tidak hambar bersama gandingan serasi Amin , Que , Mimie dan Fazrinah! Sambil melayan perjalanan pulang dari kerja, dapatkan pengisian Mutiara Ilmu, tips keusahawanan dalam Biz On Air, serta bincangkan pelbagai Isu hangat dan menarik menerusi Ralet Cheq. Tak lengkap petang anda tanpa menguji minda dalam peraduan Teka Tiara Nyanyi bersama kemaskini trafik dan berita terkini.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc:
Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".
But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We're back with a big helping of the funniest pet videos on the internet, guaranteed to make you laugh out loud.Stir-crazy hamsters, tortoises with a bad attitude, sweary parrots - they're all here

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In a very special festive edition of The Dog Rescuers, Inspector Lyndsey Taylor is called to a case of a desperate dog, left home alone at Christmas. With concern growing for the dog's health, can Lyndsey secure a warrant for police to enter the property in time?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The extremly cute capybara loves massage, black-footed penguins from Africa show off their superb diving abilities, be careful cause mini pigs aren't mini in size at all, subverting your imagination towards them, and uncovering ecology of the incredible gentle giant giraffe. "Cute Pet Guide" invites you to a trip to the zoo full of surprises!

programme.desc: It's three weeks since Barbie's operation to fix her shattered jaw. Her jaw's still held by the metal brace, but her leg bandage is finally off and. programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Alan Davies returns for a brand-new series of The Dog Rescuers and it's going to be bigger and better than ever. On this week's show, German Shepherd puppies covered in their own mess and eating raw meat off a filthy floor. They need Inspector Herchy Boal's help to get them out of their concrete cage.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Dachshund, prince of the dog world and American pitbull, the gangster boss compete to see who is the cutest? There are many problems when taking your dog out for a walk, pet trainer teaches your dog to walk well in 3 steps! What are the precautions for daily care of dogs dog owners are most concerned about? Remember to deworm regularly to give them a fullout protection! Let's make a nutritious fresh pet food cake together! Tainan’s first leisure farm designed specifically for pets, keep your furry friends entertained through spring outings and play in the water!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt gets up close and personal with Albert, Flamingoland's 12-foot alligator, as he moves to a new home. Teddy the pet sheep has suspected calcium deficiency and needs emergency treatment, and Marcel the marmoset leads Matt a merry dance around the surgery. Back at Flamingoland, a reluctant macaw needs his beak trimming -V and Matt comes face-to-face with the new pride of lions.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: The funniest cat videos on the internet are celebrated in this hilarious compilation show. From humble moggies terrorised by the toaster or getting stuck in a hamster ball -V to Grumpy Cat, whose trademark scowl has earned her more cash than a Hollywood A-lister.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Baxter is a Shih-Tzu that was discovered abandoned in an empty house on the outskirts of Manchester; thin and with extremely matted fur. Inspector Lyndsey Taylor comes to the rescue, but until all that fur is removed, nobody knows what lies beneath.

programme.title: Puppy Academy
programme.desc: Follow 6 new furry students and their humans from their first day of puppy school training all the way to graduation. Watch and learn as our star students are taught the basics as well as a handy party trick ot two.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: Signal 1203
programme.desc: Signal 1203 – The Midnight Experience on REDfm\\\\n\\\\nGet ready for a brand-new late-night adventure with Signal 1203, your ultimate companion from 12am to 3am on REDfm for Variety! This isn’t just another radio show – it’s a full-on experience. Dive into fresh, youth-focused content, spine-chilling horror stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat, and trending topics that matter to you. We have Technology, Horror, chillout music, movie reviews, crime drama and so much more!\\\\n\\\\nAnd of course, what’s a night show without killer music? We’ve got the best tracks to keep your vibe alive through the early hours. Whether you’re up late studying, driving, or just chilling, Signal 1203 is your signal for something different.\\\\n\\\\nStay tuned. Stay awake. Stay connected. Only on REDfm – for variety.\\\\n\\\\n

programme.title: Morning Music 音乐早点
programme.desc: 《音乐早点》你最贴心的早间声音伴侣。我们不聊冗长的资讯，只精选最舒缓、最动听的旋律，配合清新的晨间絮语，为你卸去昨夜的疲惫，装满清晨的能量。无论你正行走在通勤的路上，还是在享用一份惬意的早餐，让《音乐早点》用惬意的乐音，陪你开启美好而有温度的一天。

programme.title: Midday Mix Part 1
programme.desc: Playing you the best hits from the past to current hits, along with news, interviews and interesting topics.

programme.title: MIDDAY MIX PART 2
programme.desc: Our variety program for the afternoon. 1pm - 4pm. Great music, fun DJs and total entertainment for 3 hours!!

programme.title: 音乐下午茶Teabreak
programme.desc: 星期一道星期六，下午4-5点，忙碌的午后，需要适时的暂停。《音乐下午茶》 是一档专为午后时光打造的治愈系音乐随笔节目。

programme.title: 下班开麦啦
programme.desc: 叮！下班铃声响起，属于你自己的时间正式开始。《下班开麦啦》是你在晚高峰通勤路上最懂你的“解压陪伴站”。告别繁琐的工作汇报和烦人的KPI，这里只有轻松搞笑的职场吐槽、热辣接地气的社会热议，以及最治愈的音乐与故事。无论你正挤在拥挤的地铁里，还是堵在回家的车流中，戴上耳机，和我们一起开麦畅聊，把一天的疲惫一扫而空！

programme.title: 爱上说故事
programme.desc: 一首歌一个故事，菁华爱上说故事，您爱上听故事

programme.title: 歌里寻他千百回
programme.desc: 人海茫茫，我们总在别人的歌声里，寻找着自己的影子。这里是《歌里寻他千百回》，一档用旋律解构心事、用歌词安放灵魂的声音空间。每一首经典的背后，都藏着一段未完的故事；每一段动人的旋律，都是一次久别重逢。夜色渐深，请戴上耳机，跟随我们的声音，在漫漫歌海中，寻觅那个曾让你怦然心动、或是泪流满面的“他”。

programme.title: 听歌好时光
programme.desc: 忙碌的生活里，你有多久没有好好听完一首歌了？这里是《听歌好时光》，你的私享音乐会客厅。我们不设复杂的门槛，没有沉重的叙事，只挑选最惬意、最动听的旋律，为你揉碎日常的喧嚣。沏一杯清茶，或是斟一杯咖啡，在这个专属的空间里，让我们用好歌慢下来，静静享受属于你的好时光。

programme.title: 说一惠儿
programme.desc: 生活太忙，话题太重？不如停下脚步，和淑惠一起“说一会儿”。这里是《Talk with Hui 说一惠儿》，一个没有说教、不设门槛的声音客厅。每期节目，主播惠都会邀请有趣的朋友做客，或是独自坐下，聊聊日常里的奇思妙想、职场上的酸甜苦辣，以及那些打动内心的瞬间。一杯茶，麦克风前，我们今天就轻松地“说一惠儿”！

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Chapter 1 Mae Nak Reborn
programme.desc: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

programme.title: The Elite of Devils
programme.desc: Five university students are assigned a project at a mysterious estate, where they meet Lady Salakjit, an elite socialite with a deadly secret. As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Agrinai
programme.desc: At a secluded high-tech asylum hidden in the Malaysian highlands, Dr Jeghan secretly conducts biogenetic experiments on three notorious serial killers. When the experiment goes horribly wrong, the mutated killers escape into the jungle as ruthless, pain-free predators, unleashing an unstoppable wave of terror and bloodshed.

Dr. Manning pula terus bergelut untuk mencari diagnosis tepat bagi seorang pesakit muda selepas beberapa kali tersalah diagnosis, dan berada di persimpangan dalam hubungannya dengan Phillip dan Dr. Halstead.
